calculation.description: Invert the volatility-adjusted blend of 20-day and 60-day log returns. Cross-sectional higher values represent assets whose recent leadership is more likely to mean-revert over the forward horizon. Inputs end on the prior completed trading day.

validation.regime_notes: Raw leadership signal was negatively predictive at 10 days (IC -0.036095, ICIR -0.116552); the persisted direction reverses it. Regime IC after inversion: 2020-2024 -0.028689, 2025-2027 +0.024888, 2028-2029 +0.038558, 2030-2032-01-21 +0.138389. Cross-sectional observations use at least 8 valid names and normally 15 tradable instruments; uncertainty is interpreted conservatively.

provenance.validation_method: daily Spearman cross-sectional IC against forward 10-day returns
